answer: Each identity must haul a bonded timber of unique attested jobs through a narrow inlet before its votes count: registration is a one-way channel of sequential, non-transferable receipts that peers countersign on-ledger. Weight accumulates only after the account crosses that ridge of history. An attacker minting a thousand keys still pays the same scarce compute plus slashed collateral per fake, so swarming cost scales with herd size, not with copy-paste.
